question: Kanchan sold 153 chairs and had a gain equal to the selling price of 78 chairs. What is his profit percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Selling Price (SP) of 1 chair be 1 unit.

Total SP of 153 chairs = 153 units.

Gain = SP of 78 chairs = 78 units.

Cost Price (CP) = Total SP − Gain = 153 − 78 = 75 units.

Profit % = (Gain ÷ CP) × 100 = (78 ÷ 75) × 100 = 104%.

**∴ The correct answer is 104%.**
